fields: (a grid block, as: "route"): h, nav, items [{t, d, draw, link}]. draw: the drawing kind (washer, ultrasonic, sink, endoscope, cart, sterilizer); without it the kind is read from the name. The sheet code is the kind's initials (WD, UC, MS, ER, CW, SF), a drawing label only. Every item's name and line are always in the page (the detail is a visual copy, aria-hidden).
best_for: DrawingRegister sets a short list of places water goes as a drawing register on a limestone sheet: a row of framed outline drawings with mono sheet codes, one steel-blue viewfinder over the selected drawing, and under the row that item's drawing at large with its notes and a title block.
